sin.name: whole-output-read-in-a-tick
sin.description: A function that advances a reader on each tick (it takes is_final) reads the whole output of the run, so every tick reads a file that only grows.
sin.rule: Read the bytes after the reader's offset on a tick, and the whole output only in the final read: put the whole read behind an is_final return, or keep the counts the reader has already found.
